verdict.rationale: The pricing page refers to a first-party Docs feature with collaborators and proposed-change visibility, which shows Shortcut has shared docs. That is a single thin mention: nothing documents creating, organizing, or linking docs to stories or epics. Missing for 10: documented doc creation, doc organization (folders/collections), linking docs to project work, notes functionality, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work

citations.quote: Allow Doc collaborators to see what changes are proposed
